summary: Add indexed inactive jobs queries, requester-isolated atomic receipts and migration/replay fixtures.

replay.detail: Open catches up existing job-only history. Rebuild atomically recomputes each subject's receipt with its canonical history. Refold checks the bounded subject count before sorting or changing tables. Earlier canonical submissions win; changed-digest repeats and changed bindings are refused history.

schema.detail: Populate the previously declared receipt table with composite (requester,key) uniqueness. Receipt-bearing claims are durable, never rotated away. Job IDs are versioned SHA-256 identities of requester/key, so receipt conflicts remain within one subject.

rules.detail: No execution admission or host activation. Pure unit-2 idempotency decisions are used within the same SQLite transaction as job rows and transition history.

compatibility.detail: Expose history-only job lookup, host queue in canonical order, transition history and receipt lookup. Queue reads require an explicit transaction snapshot. No public submit endpoint or execution-authority evidence constructor exists.

recovery.detail: Durable canonical claims reconstruct job rows, receipts and refused transition histories. These history rows never authorize local execution; admission wiring remains separately gated.
